description:
Update the existing TimescaleDB cloud deployment mode to reflect the
TigerData rebrand (Timescale → TigerData, Timescale Cloud → TigerData).
Rename environment variables from TIMESCALE_* to TIGERDATA_* (with backward
compatibility), update registry display names, error messages, docstrings,
and tests. Add platform documentation, example scripts, and comparison
matrix entry consistent with other cloud adapters.

The core cloud connection logic already works (SSL, service URL parsing,
env var auth, skip_database_management). This TODO focuses on the rebrand
alignment and the documentation/example gap.

Note: TigerData still uses *.tsdb.cloud.timescale.com hostnames, tsdbadmin
default user, and tsdb default database - the infrastructure is unchanged,
only the branding.

anti_patterns.instead: cloud rebrand changes only affect cloud-mode code paths and user-facing strings
anti_patterns.why: self-hosted users depend on current behavior

anti_patterns.dont: change the colon syntax from timescaledb:cloud
anti_patterns.instead: update only display_name and description in registry
anti_patterns.why: this is the established convention and TimescaleDB is still the extension name

anti_patterns.instead: add TIGERDATA_* as primary with TIMESCALE_* as documented fallback
anti_patterns.why: existing users may have these configured

anti_patterns.dont: rename the adapter module from timescaledb.py
anti_patterns.instead: only update display names and user-facing strings
anti_patterns.why: TimescaleDB is still the extension name and the platform identifier

deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Reason explicitly states this was moved to tigerdata-cloud-enhancements, which is open (planning).
deferrals.summary: Connection pooling, verify-full SSL, and live integration tests

preserves.behavior: All existing platform adapter tests pass: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms/ -v --tb=short
Existing TimescaleDB unit tests continue to pass: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms/test_timescaledb_adapter.py -v
Existing self-hosted TimescaleDB mode unchanged - no behavior change for self-hosted users
Platform registry autodiscovery continues working for all existing platforms
TIMESCALE_* environment variables still work (backward compatibility)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import os; os.environ['TIGERDATA_HOST']='x.com'; os.environ['TIGERDATA_PASSWORD']='p'; from benchbox.platforms.timescaledb import TimescaleDBAdapter; a = TimescaleDBAdapter(deployment_mode='cloud'); assert a.host == 'x.com'; print('OK')"

uv run -- python -c "import os; os.environ['TIMESCALE_HOST']='y.com'; os.environ['TIMESCALE_PASSWORD']='p'; from benchbox.platforms.timescaledb import TimescaleDBAdapter; a = TimescaleDBAdapter(deployment_mode='cloud'); assert a.host == 'y.com'; print('OK')"
